parameters.name: ComponentIds
parameters.description: The IDs of Dataset Accelerator components. Separate multiple component IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Dataset Accelerator component. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- Desc: descending order.
- Asc: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the component list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of components to display per page in a paged query. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: The version of the Dataset Accelerator component.
